title: Fruitfall
subtitle: Hyper-Casual | Mobile Game | Android
content: Hyper-casual mobile game using Unity and C# for Android platform.
summary: Built and released a lightweight Android catch-and-avoid game with custom 2D art and leaderboards.
description: A hyper-casual Android game where players catch falling fruit while avoiding hazards. The project focused on a simple, readable loop, quick sessions, and mobile-friendly controls.
roles: Designed and developed the core game concept
Integrated Google Play services for leaderboard elements
Released the game on Google Play and provided small bug-fix updates
details: Built in Unity and C# over a short development sprint, Fruitfall is a simple mobile game where players move a basket horizontally to catch falling fruit while avoiding hazards. The game includes three initial levels with escalating challenge. I independently developed the project from scratch, including the 2D assets, gameplay loop, and release preparation.
